question: Has the current assurance report been evaluated?
Does the contract include audit and escalation rights?
Is SSO enforced in the proposed workspace?
Are administrators protected by verified MFA?
Are customer-managed keys suitable for this use case?
Is public sharing disabled for sensitive pages?
Has export and exit recovery been tested?
Are privacy and processing terms discoverable?
Is the required processing location contractually confirmed?
Is deletion completion evidenced for the intended data?
Are AI processing terms and configuration approved?
Is a customer recovery exercise completed?
Is breach notification timing contractually agreed?
Has the supplier contact route been exercised?
